name: Samadhi of Tanaji Malusare
description: The samadhi (tomb) of Tanaji Malusare, the legendary Maratha warrior who led the daring capture of Kondhana (Sinhagad) Fort in 1670. His sacrifice is immortalized in Maratha history and folklore.
historicalSignificance: Final resting place of Tanaji Malusare, hero of the Battle of Sinhagad (1670).

landmarks.name: Tanaji Malusare Samadhi
landmarks.description: Simple tomb at Sinhagad Fort, revered by visitors.

reviews: A place of great pride and emotion.
The story of Tanaji comes alive here.
